data.name: Twistingo: Tree of Life Collector’s Edition
data.detailed_description:
Twistingo: Tree of Life – Journey to the enchanted island of Lumira, where mysterious glowing fungi have overtaken this tropical paradise! Join Raya in a desperate search for her missing husband, Kadek, a dedicated biologist who ventured deep into the island seeking an ancient cure. With her leg broken and time running out, Raya needs your help to follow his trail through sacred temples, misty waterfalls, and snow-capped peaks to reach the legendary Tree of Life.

Key Features:

  • Choose Your Play Style: Enjoy traditional hidden object gameplay with the option to add bingo levels for extra challenge – it's your adventure, your way!

  • Enhanced HOPA Elements: Dive deeper into the hidden object puzzle adventure experience with more intricate scenes, interactive objects, and challenging puzzles than ever before in this captivating sequel.

  • Heartwarming Rescue Story: Follow Raya's emotional journey to save her husband and restore balance to Lumira.

  • Explore Five Stunning Locations: Travel from Raya's house through mysterious forests, ancient temples, cascading waterfalls, and snowy summits to the sacred Tree of Life.

  • Solve Engaging Puzzles: Unlock secret boxes, piece together map sketches, and complete unique tile matching challenges to uncover Kadek's path.

  • Collect Ancient Seeds: Gather powerful, spore-resistant seeds to heal the island and restore its natural beauty.

  • Rebuild the Community: Purchase collectibles like seaplanes, submarine pods, and solar boats to help Lumira's village thrive again.

  • Beautiful Immersive Experience: Stunning Balinese-inspired art and cinematic scenes with atmospheric audio bring this mystical island adventure to life.

Can you reunite Raya with her beloved husband and unlock the secrets of the Tree of Life before the toxic mushrooms consume everything? The island's breath depends on you. Play Twistingo: Tree of Life now and restore harmony to Lumira!
